notes: Zales' current logotype: geometric caps with the crossbar-less A whose counter is a separate inverted-triangle 'diamond' (traced as its own shape), dark charcoal flat-faced letters about 5 cm deep standing off the wall, halo-lit (cool white light on the wall round every letter, clearly on in IMG_4435 and IMG_4424). One spec for both signs on the corner (north-facing narrow bay and west-facing long bay; they are identical in the frames). Traced from IMG_4435 (sharp). Size: letters ~0.5 m, word ~2.27 m (from the fascia and ~3 m opening, +-15%).
